scientific_correction: V3 incorrectly used private/observed language for mechanisms that historical public raw data cannot identify. V4 labels all historical maker fills as synthetic strict-trade-through full-fill proxies, the 60ms cancel event as a synthetic scenario, FOK as a public-book counterfactual, and self-cross checks as limited to the simulated strategy-order registry.

official_exchange_sources.title: Order directions
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: bid is YES and ask is NO; selling YES is economically buying NO; buying YES reduces a held NO position

official_exchange_sources.title: Create Order V2
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: fill_or_kill, reduce_only, and self_trade_prevention_type are supported protocol fields

official_exchange_sources.title: Kalshi Fee Schedule
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: The event-contract maker-fee formula has default multiplier M=0 unless a series is listed with a nonzero multiplier; KXBTC15M is not in the schedule's non-standard-fee list. The general taker formula is round_up(M*0.07*C*P*(1-P)) with default M=1. The schedule also states there is no settlement fee.
official_exchange_sources.inference: For KXBTC15M rows governed by this frozen schedule, first and complement resting-maker fees are zero. This is a schedule-based simulation input, not a private fee receipt. The schedule must be revalidated before any future-date or deployment use.

official_exchange_sources.title: Market outcomes
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: outcomes are determined from each contract's rules and named source after expiry

official_exchange_sources.title: Prediction-market payout
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: a correct standard binary contract is worth one dollar

provenance_contract.simulation_exact_definition: The arithmetic is exact conditional on the explicitly serialized public-proxy, fee-schedule, or official-result mechanism. SIMULATION_EXACT never means that a private execution or fee receipt was observed.

latency_scenario.limitation: The engineering sample motivates a conservative 60ms scenario only. It is not an observed acknowledgement for each historical action, a measured p99, or a production SLA.

decision_state.remaining_inventory_rule: remaining_inventory_fp = requested_qty_fp = first_fill_qty_fp at every at-risk grid; the public full-fill proxy does not identify partial maker fills
decision_state.queue_state_rule: The original complement order keeps its original id and price. Public queue position, same-price-ahead, better depth, and flow may evolve causally at each grid; replacement or repricing is forbidden.

touch_missingness.two_sided_touch_available_false: touch imbalance, spread, and all midpoint moves are NULL

historical_primary_kernel.reason: public raw history has no receive timestamp that makes the external five-second source-time value causal at the decision receipt

KEEP.rule: Leave the original resting complement maker order unchanged in price and queue identity.
KEEP.complement_terminal: Only a public strict-trade-through full-fill proxy at the original complement price.
KEEP.hard_fallback_terminal: Only at market close, using the official YES/NO result, binary payout arithmetic, and zero settlement fee.
KEEP.current_policy_comparator: CURRENT_DIST2_TTL60 remains an independent comparator and never terminates KEEP training.

canonical_v2_mapping.held_YES: ASK: sell YES; walk YES bids best to worse
canonical_v2_mapping.held_NO: BID: buy YES to reduce NO; walk YES asks best to worse

FLATTEN_FOK.self_cross_claim_limit: Only orders in the simulated strategy registry are checked; no statement is made about all orders in a real account or subaccount.

price_and_book_counterfactual.full_visible_clip: freeze the public decision-time canonical walk and set the FOK limit to the worst full-clip level plus one adverse legal tick, capped at the legal boundary
price_and_book_counterfactual.incomplete_visible_clip: use the adverse legal boundary with flatten_limit_fallback=true
price_and_book_counterfactual.atomicity: FOK_FULL or FOK_ZERO; partial FOK is forbidden

CANCEL_RACE_PAIR.definition: The public strict-trade-through full-fill proxy for the unchanged complement order occurs strictly before synthetic cancel application.

FOK_FULL.definition: The public-book counterfactual fills the complete clip at the frozen limit after the synthetic cancel and simulated-registry no-self-cross gate.

FOK_ZERO.definition: The public-book counterfactual fills zero and retains the complete requested inventory.

economics.fok_full_net_band_usd: gross - taker_fee_band; maker fee is zero

ddl_scope.shared_dependency_normative_scope: Only the postfill_zero_time_atom table and its V4 public-origin/provenance extension are normative for this contract.

required_negative_tests: HARD_FALLBACK with nonzero exit or settlement fee
nonzero first or complement maker fee
partial at-risk inventory or partial FOK
